summary: A responsive blog platform with account authentication, owned post management, search and filtering, and comments.

services.name: Frontend
services.description: Responsive React user interface built with Vite.

services.name: Backend API
services.description: Node.js and Express REST API using MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, JWT, and bcrypt.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a maintainable default for a new React/Vite application.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for safer application development.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Standard JavaScript without static type annotations.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build tool should be used?
questions.rationale: This is the frontend stack explicitly requested.

options.label: React with Vite
options.description: React application developed and bundled with Vite.

questions.question: What frontend features and experience are needed?
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive modern UI for registration/sign-in, browsing and searching posts, post details, and creating/editing/deleting posts and comments.
questions.answer: Responsive modern UI for registration/sign-in, browsing and searching posts, post details, and creating/editing/deleting posts and comments. Include loading, empty, validation, and error states.
questions.rationale: Covers the requested blog workflows and routine user-facing states.

questions.question: Which language should the backend use?
questions.rationale: JavaScript is the straightforward default for the explicitly requested Node.js/Express backend.

questions.question: Which backend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: Express is explicitly requested; retain this custom framework rather than substituting Azure Functions.

questions.question: What backend features and API behavior are needed?
questions.recommendedChoice: REST API with account registration/sign-in using bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication; CRUD blog posts with author ownership checks; post search/filter; CRUD comments associated with posts and authenticated authors; input validation and consistent errors.
questions.answer: REST API with account registration/sign-in using bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication; CRUD blog posts with author ownership checks; post search/filter; CRUD comments associated with posts and authenticated authors; input validation and consistent errors. Store credentials and secrets only in environment configuration; provide an .env.example containing placeholders, never real secrets.
questions.rationale: Implements the requested authentication, content, authorization, comments, and configuration scope.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: MongoDB Atlas with Mongoose is explicitly requested; no file upload or queue requirement was specified.

options.label: MongoDB Atlas
options.description: Managed MongoDB database for users, posts, and comments.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use when the application does not need persistence, file/object storage, queues, or caches.

questions.question: Do users sign in to use application API features?
questions.rationale: Account registration and sign-in with JWT and bcrypt are explicitly requested.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate to access protected application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: No user sign-in is required for application API features.
